passages.text: So the LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your father’s house must bear the iniquity involving the sanctuary. And you and your sons alone must bear the iniquity involving your priesthood.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Aaron.
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
The LORD said, "You must bear responsibility for the sins connected to the sanctuary."
Your sons must also bear this responsibility with you.
Your father's house, the family of priests, must share this duty with you.
You and your sons alone must bear the responsibility for the sins connected to your priesthood.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבֵית־ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But bring with you also your brothers from the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may join you and assist you and your sons before the Tent of the Testimony.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
God spoke to Aaron.
God told Aaron to bring his brothers from the tribe of Levi.
The tribe of Levi was Aaron’s own tribe.
Aaron must bring the Levites to serve with him.
The Levites must join Aaron and his sons.
The Levites must help Aaron and his sons.
They must serve together before the Tent of the Testimony.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־ אַחֶיךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֙יךָ֙ הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔ךְ וְיִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖יךָ וִֽישָׁרְת֑וּךָ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃

passages.text: And they shall attend to your duties and to all the duties of the Tent; but they must not come near to the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron.
God gave Aaron and his sons special duties in the sanctuary.
God appointed the Levites to help Aaron and his sons.
The Levites must guard Aaron’s duties.
The Levites must also guard all the duties of the Tent.
The Levites must not go near the holy objects in the sanctuary.
The Levites must not go near the altar.
If the Levites go near the holy objects or the altar, they will die.
If the Levites go near the holy objects or the altar, Aaron and his sons will also die.
passages.original: וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּךָ֔ וּמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כָּל־ הָאֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל־ כְּלֵ֨י הַקֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ וְלֹֽא־ יָמֻ֥תוּ גַם־ הֵ֖ם גַּם־ אַתֶּֽם׃

passages.text: They are to join you and attend to the duties of the Tent of Meeting, doing all the work at the Tent; but no outsider may come near you.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are your brothers.
The Levites come from the tribe of Levi.
The Levites join you.
The Levites help you.
The Levites watch over the Tent of Meeting.
The Levites do all the work at the Tent.
No outsider may come near you.
passages.original: וְנִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְשָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל וְזָ֖ר לֹא־ יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and of the altar, so that wrath may not fall on the Israelites again.
passages.sermon:
You are priests of Israel.
You must guard the sanctuary.
You must guard the altar.
You must do these duties carefully.
If you do this, God’s anger will not come upon the Israelites again.
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד קֶ֖צֶף עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron.
God chose the Levites from among the Israelites.
The Levites are your brothers.
God gave the Levites to you as a gift.
The Levites belong to the LORD.
The Levites must serve at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֶ֞ם מַתָּנָ֤ה נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: But only you and your sons shall attend to your priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil, and you are to perform that service. I am giving you the work of the priesthood as a gift, but any outsider who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron.
Aaron, you are a priest.
Your sons are priests with you.
You and your sons must guard your priesthood.
You must care for everything about the altar.
You must care for everything inside the veil.
You must do this work.
I give you the work of the priesthood as a gift.
No outsider may come near the sanctuary.
If an outsider comes near, he must be put to death.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִ֠תְּךָ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת־ כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֜ם לְכָל־ דְּבַ֧ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּלְמִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹ֖כֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם עֲבֹדַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־ כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֔ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “Behold, I have put you in charge of My offerings. As for all the sacred offerings of the Israelites, I have given them to you and your sons as a portion and a permanent statute.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Aaron.
The LORD gave Aaron a special responsibility.
Aaron must oversee the LORD’s offerings.
These offerings are the sacred gifts from the Israelites.
The LORD gave these offerings to Aaron and his sons.
This gift is for Aaron’s anointing as priest.
This rule will last forever.
Aaron and his sons will always receive these offerings.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֒ וַאֲנִי֙ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֔ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑י לְכָל־ קָדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְךָ֨ נְתַתִּ֧ים לְמָשְׁחָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ לְחָק־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: A portion of the most holy offerings reserved from the fire will be yours. From all the offerings they render to Me as most holy offerings, whether grain offerings or sin offerings or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron.
God gave Aaron and his sons special duties as priests.
God said, “You and your sons will receive a portion from the most holy offerings.
These offerings are set apart as most holy.
The Israelites bring these offerings to Me.
Some offerings are grain offerings.
Some offerings are sin offerings.
Some offerings are guilt offerings.
The part that is most holy belongs to you and your sons.
These portions come from what is burned on the altar.
You and your sons may have these holy parts.”
passages.original: זֶֽה־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ מִקֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים מִן־ הָאֵ֑שׁ כָּל־ קָ֠רְבָּנָם לְֽכָל־ מִנְחָתָ֞ם וּלְכָל־ חַטָּאתָ֗ם וּלְכָל־ אֲשָׁמָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים לְךָ֛ ה֖וּא וּלְבָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron.
God gave Aaron and his sons the most holy offerings from the Israelites.
Aaron must eat these offerings as most holy food.
Every male in Aaron’s family may eat this food.
This food is holy for Aaron and his sons.
passages.original: בְּקֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים תֹּאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ כָּל־ זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹת֔וֹ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: And this is yours as well: the offering of their gifts, along with all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I have given this to you and your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat it.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron the priest.
God gave Aaron special rights.
God gave Aaron the offerings that the Israelites bring as gifts.
These offerings include all the wave offerings from the Israelites.
God gave these offerings to Aaron.
God also gave them to Aaron’s sons and daughters.
This rule will last forever.
Every person in Aaron’s household who is ceremonially clean may eat these offerings.
passages.original: וְזֶה־ לְּךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ם לְכָל־ תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֗ים וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־ עוֹלָ֑ם כָּל־ טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I give you all the freshest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain that the Israelites give to the LORD as their firstfruits.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the priests.
God gives the priests special gifts.
God gives the priests all the best olive oil.
God gives the priests all the best new wine.
God gives the priests all the best grain.
The Israelites bring these as their firstfruits to the LORD.
God gives these firstfruits to the priests.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְכָל־ חֵ֖לֶב תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְדָגָ֑ן רֵאשִׁיתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ יִתְּנ֥וּ לַֽיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֥ נְתַתִּֽים׃

passages.text: The firstfruits of everything in their land that they bring to the LORD will belong to you. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat them.
passages.sermon:
God gave the firstfruits of everything in the land of the Israelites to the priests.
The Israelites bring these firstfruits to the LORD.
These firstfruits belong to the priests.
Every person in the priest’s household who is ceremonially clean may eat these firstfruits.
passages.original: בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאַרְצָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ יָבִ֥יאוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֣ יִהְיֶ֑ה כָּל־ טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Every devoted thing in Israel belongs to you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the priests of Israel.
God gave the priests special rights.
Every devoted thing in Israel belongs to the priests.
A devoted thing is something set apart for God.
No one else may claim it.
The priests receive all things dedicated in this way.
passages.original: כָּל־ חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: The firstborn of every womb, whether man or beast, that is offered to the LORD belongs to you. But you must surely redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.
passages.sermon:
God gave these instructions to the priests of Israel.
The firstborn of every womb belongs to the priests.
This includes both people and animals.
The people and animals must be offered to the LORD.
The priests receive them as their portion.
You must redeem every firstborn son.
You must also redeem every firstborn male of unclean animals.
passages.original: כָּל־ פֶּ֣טֶר רֶ֠חֶם לְֽכָל־ בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ יַקְרִ֧יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֛ה בָּאָדָ֥ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ׀ פָּדֹ֣ה תִפְדֶּ֗ה אֵ֚ת בְּכ֣וֹר הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְאֵ֛ת בְּכֽוֹר־ הַבְּהֵמָ֥ה הַטְּמֵאָ֖ה תִּפְדֶּֽה׃

passages.text: You are to pay the redemption price for a month-old male according to your valuation: five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.
passages.sermon:
God gave the Levites special duties in Israel.
The Levites must redeem every firstborn male child who is one month old.
You must pay a price to redeem him.
The price is five shekels of silver.
You must use the sanctuary shekel to measure the silver.
One sanctuary shekel equals twenty gerahs.
passages.original: וּפְדוּיָו֙ מִבֶּן־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֨רְכְּךָ֔ כֶּ֛סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox, a sheep, or a goat; they are holy. You are to sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave special instructions to the priests of Israel.
The firstborn of an ox, a sheep, or a goat is holy.
You must not redeem the firstborn of these animals.
You must sprinkle their blood on the altar.
You must burn their fat as an offering by fire.
This offering is a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ בְּֽכוֹר־ שׁ֡וֹר אֽוֹ־ בְכ֨וֹר כֶּ֜שֶׂב אֽוֹ־ בְכ֥וֹר עֵ֛ז לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑ם אֶת־ דָּמָ֞ם תִּזְרֹ֤ק עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וְאֶת־ חֶלְבָּ֣ם תַּקְטִ֔יר אִשֶּׁ֛ה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And their meat belongs to you, just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron and his descendants.
God gave them special rights among the Israelites.
God said, “The meat of these offerings will belong to you.
You will receive the meat just as you receive the breast of the wave offering.
You will also receive the right thigh, as with the wave offering.
These parts are your portion from the offerings.”
passages.original: וּבְשָׂרָ֖ם יִהְיֶה־ לָּ֑ךְ כַּחֲזֵ֧ה הַתְּנוּפָ֛ה וּכְשׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: All the holy offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and to your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. It is a permanent covenant of salt before the LORD for you and your offspring.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron.
God gave Aaron a special role.
The Israelites bring holy offerings to the LORD.
God gives all these holy offerings to Aaron.
God also gives them to Aaron’s sons and daughters.
This rule will never end.
God made this a permanent law.
God calls it a covenant of salt.
This covenant stands before the LORD.
It belongs to Aaron and his descendants forever.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ל׀ תְּרוּמֹ֣ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ימוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לַֽיהוָה֒ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֗ וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־ עוֹלָ֑ם בְּרִית֩ מֶ֨לַח עוֹלָ֥ם הִוא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אִתָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Aaron.
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
The LORD said, “You will not receive land in Israel.
You will not have a share among the other tribes.
I, the LORD, am your portion.
I am your inheritance among the Israelites.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ לֹ֣א תִנְחָ֔ל וְחֵ֕לֶק לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: Behold, I have given to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work they do, the service of the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe in Israel.
The Levites do not receive land as an inheritance among the Israelites.
God gives the Levites all the tithes from the people of Israel.
The tithes are their inheritance.
God gives the tithes to the Levites because they serve.
The Levites work in the Tent of Meeting.
They perform the service required there.
God gives the tithes to the Levites as payment for their work.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הִנֵּ֥ה נָתַ֛תִּי כָּל־ מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְנַחֲלָ֑ה חֵ֤לֶף עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֣ם עֹֽבְדִ֔ים אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: No longer may the Israelites come near to the Tent of Meeting, or they will incur guilt and die.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are God's chosen people.
The Tent of Meeting is a holy place.
God commands the Israelites.
The Israelites must not come near the Tent of Meeting.
If the Israelites come near, they will become guilty.
If the Israelites come near, they will die.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יִקְרְב֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לָשֵׂ֥את חֵ֖טְא לָמֽוּת׃

passages.text: The Levites are to perform the work of the Tent of Meeting, and they must bear their iniquity. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come. The Levites will not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe in Israel.
The Levites must do the work at the Tent of Meeting.
The Levites must carry the responsibility for any wrongdoing related to this work.
God made this rule permanent for all generations.
The Levites will not receive land as an inheritance among the Israelites.
passages.original: וְעָבַ֨ד הַלֵּוִ֜י ה֗וּא אֶת־ עֲבֹדַת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהֵ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ עֲוֺנָ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃

passages.text: For I have given to the Levites as their inheritance the tithe that the Israelites present to the LORD as a contribution. That is why I told them that they would not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.”
passages.sermon:
God gave the Levites a special role.
The Levites serve God in the Tent of Meeting.
God did not give the Levites land among the Israelites.
God gave the Levites the tithe as their inheritance.
The Israelites bring a tithe as a contribution to the LORD.
God gives this tithe to the Levites.
This is why the Levites do not receive land among the Israelites.
passages.original: כִּ֞י אֶת־ מַעְשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤ימוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ תְּרוּמָ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי לַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּן֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֔ם בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD instructed Moses, “Speak to the Levites and tell them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that I have given you as your inheritance, you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD—a tithe of the tithe.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Levites.
The Levites are a tribe in Israel.
The Levites do not receive land as an inheritance among the Israelites.
The Levites receive the tithe from the Israelites as their inheritance.
The LORD told Moses to say this to the Levites:
“When you receive the tithe from the Israelites,
I, the LORD, have given you this tithe as your inheritance.
You must take part of this tithe.
You must present this part as an offering to the LORD.
This offering is a tithe of the tithe.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ וְאֶל־ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם תְּדַבֵּר֮ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶם֒ כִּֽי־ תִ֠קְחוּ מֵאֵ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם מֵאִתָּ֖ם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶ֤ם מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִן־ הַֽמַּעֲשֵֽׂר׃

passages.text: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Levites.
God told the Levites to give an offering to Him.
God said, "Your offering is important."
God will count your offering as grain from the threshing floor.
God will count your offering as juice from the winepress.
passages.original: וְנֶחְשַׁ֥ב לָכֶ֖ם תְּרוּמַתְכֶ֑ם כַּדָּגָן֙ מִן־ הַגֹּ֔רֶן וְכַֽמְלֵאָ֖ה מִן־ הַיָּֽקֶב׃

passages.text: So you are to present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites, and from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave instructions for the Levites.
The Levites receive tithes from the Israelites.
These tithes are the Levites’ inheritance from God.
The Levites must take an offering from these tithes.
This offering belongs to the LORD.
The Levites must give this offering to Aaron the priest.
passages.original: כֵּ֣ן תָּרִ֤ימוּ גַם־ אַתֶּם֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְח֔וּ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ אֶת־ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Levites to give Him offerings.
The Levites must give an offering to the LORD.
They must give this offering from every gift they receive.
They must choose the best part from each gift.
They must give the holiest part to the LORD.
passages.original: מִכֹּל֙ מַתְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תָּרִ֕ימוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מִכָּל־ חֶלְבּ֔וֹ אֶֽת־ מִקְדְּשׁ֖וֹ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.
passages.sermon:
The Levites serve God in the Tent of Meeting.
They receive tithes from the Israelites.
God commands the Levites to give the best part of these tithes as an offering to Him.
You must say this to the Levites.
When you give the best part from what you receive,
God will count the rest for you as if it were your own harvest.
It will be like the grain from a threshing floor.
It will be like the wine from a winepress.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֤ם אֶת־ חֶלְבּוֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כִּתְבוּאַ֥ת גֹּ֖רֶן וְכִתְבוּאַ֥ת יָֽקֶב׃

passages.text: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Levites.
God gave the Levites a special instruction.
The Levites serve in the Tent of Meeting.
God gives the Levites a portion from the offerings.
The Levites and their families may eat this portion.
They may eat it anywhere.
This portion is their payment.
God gives this payment because the Levites work in the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּכָל־ מָק֔וֹם אַתֶּ֖ם וּבֵֽיתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ שָׂכָ֥ר הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם חֵ֥לֶף עֲבֹֽדַתְכֶ֖ם בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Levites.
The Levites must present the best part of the offering.
When the Levites give the best part, they do not become guilty because of it.
The Levites must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites.
If the Levites defile the sacred offerings, they will die.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֥ם אֶת־ חֶלְבּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְאֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֹ֥א תְחַלְּל֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָמֽוּתוּ׃פ
